title: Speedy Dukkah-Crusted Haloumi Wraps
subtitle: with Tomato and Mint
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our speedy recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Thinly slice the cucumber. Cut the tomato into 1cm chunks. Pick the mint leaves, discarding the stems. Slice the haloumi.

Prep toppings: Put 2 tsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp white wine vinegar and ½ tsp sugar in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Add the cucumber and toss to coat. Put the tomato in a separate bowl and season with salt and pepper.

Coat and cook haloumi: Put the dukkah and 1 tbs plain flour in a shallow bowl and season with salt and pepper (see Kitchen notes). Coat the haloumi in the dukkah mixture. Heat 1½ tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the haloumi for 2-3 mins each side until golden and cooked through. Remove from the pan.
Warm tortillas: Put the tortillas on a plate, slightly overlapping, and microwave for 30 secs or until warmed through (see Kitchen notes).
Serve up: Divide the tortillas among plates. Spread with 1½ tbs mayonnaise and top with the cucumber, tomato, haloumi and mint leaves. Fold the tortillas over to enclose and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: Short on time? Skip coating the haloumi and simply pan-fry, then scatter over the dukkah to serve. ~ If you don't have a microwave, heat a large frypan over medium-high heat. Warm the tortillas, in batches, for 30 secs each side or until warmed through.
